name: 85031 · Phoenix, AZ
findings: ZIP 85031 (Phoenix) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85031 (Phoenix) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85031 (Phoenix) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 31% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.
